svg.aria-label: North Korea with five partners, GDELT Events, 2026-08-16 to 2026-11-14
svg.text: North Korea with five partners: GDELT Events, 16 Aug to 14 Nov 2026 (UTC days)
Counted per article (distinct source URL). Blue line: North Korea as actor (PRK→partner). Orange line: partner as actor (partner→PRK).
Dashed ticks: dated events naming that partner (docs/relations/korea_events.json); triangles: missile launches. Lines start after 7 complete days.
Articles a day, both directions (blue: z ≥ 2.5)
